description: Parkings en ouvrage à Blois is a dataset listed in Blois-Agglopolys open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Blois. Coverage: Agglopolys, Blois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are parking. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence ouverte / open licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-blois-agglopolys-fr-portal.
